texture_family: matte archival cardstock with clean knife-cut bevels, subtle paper grain tooth, and physical sheet layering
palette_summary: cool cyan and pale sky-blue atmosphere, warm cream and bone-white structural elements, muted lavender and slate stone bases, warm straw yellow, and restrained coral-orange accents reserved for load stress, structural compression, and fracture points
line_treatment: crisp silhouette cut edges and pressed sculptural creases with zero drawn ink outlines
lighting: soft directional studio illumination casting tangible cast shadows between layered paper depths to articulate physical mass and cross-sectional scale
frame_language: Full-bleed subject-world composition, extending naturally to all four image edges; consistent medium, palette, lighting and spatial depth, with fresh composition per beat.
subtitle_reserve: no dedicated caption reserve; the scene and matching texture fill the complete illustration height
subject_constraints: Massive human silhouette scale, elephant column leg geometry, cross-sections of bone thickness versus volumetric load, tree-trunk skeletal comparisons, and biomechanical stress vectors rendered purely as tactile paper constructions
hero_rendering_in_world: Constructed from layered matte paper silhouette planes with clean cut edges matching the dimensional cardstock world
negative_constraints: No enclosing frames, shadowbox borders, card margins, inset windows, or page edges; no visible glue, wires, or digital vector flatting; no embedded text, typographic callouts, labels, or anatomical gore
reason: Direct operator directive mandates a new style in a paper cut medium. Translating the square-cube law into layered cut paper provides clear physical separation between volume layers and cross-sectional bone thickness, avoiding graphic injury while clearly communicating mechanical failure.
style_subtitle_reserve: Calm natural atmosphere only in the bottom 8-10%; no separate panel or printed text.
